policy: Reference tools are local, untrusted-input processes. Their output is evidence for a named observation only; consensus never replaces the PDF standard or fixture intent.

tools.commandNormalization: mutool draw -F txt -o - <file> <page> for extraction; mutool draw for render
qpdf --check <file> for structural acceptance; qpdf --json for object observations

limitations: does not prove text extraction or object preservation
renders the MediaBox on some builds where excise/mutool/pdfium render the CropBox; excluded from majority MISSING_CONTENT voting when boxes disagree (#970/#972)
a single extractor cannot report its own blind spot (#1372); always paired with mutool, never used alone as the sole leak oracle

tools.commandNormalization: PdfBoxReferenceRenderer / PdfBoxReferenceRedactor invoke the highest-versioned tools/vendor/pdfbox-app-*.jar (or EXCISE_PDFBOX_JAR) via /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin/java when present, else bare java
limitations: needs a real JRE; the macOS system java stub reports 'Unable to locate a Java Runtime' even though `which java` resolves

tools.commandNormalization: PdfiumNativeReferenceRenderer spawns `dotnet <host> pdfium-render --pdf <file> --page <n> --dpi <dpi> --output <png>` (Excise.RenderTools, EXCISE_PDFIUM_INPROC=1) rather than linking the library in-process (#1369: not thread-safe, a native crash cannot be caught in managed code)
limitations: never loaded in-process outside the host it is spawned in
API is not thread-safe; every call is serialised on one lock
tools.execution: out-of-process host (Excise.RenderTools pdfium-render) with timeout/resource limits

tools.commandNormalization: verapdf --format xml -f <flavour> <file> for PDF/A conformance validation
observations: PDF/A-1b and PDF/A-2b conformance validation of excise-written output
limitations: validates PDF/A profile conformance only, not general PDF correctness
not a renderer or text-extraction oracle

tools.commandNormalization: project adapter scripts/benchmark-adapters/redact-pymupdf.py, invoked via the vendored xray-venv interpreter (which also carries the x-ray tooling) rather than the system python3 -m fitz
limitations: a competitor being graded by the redaction bench, not a corroborating oracle for excise's own correctness
